description: (Na)₂KScF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a KScF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 16-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the KScF₆ framework, K is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form KF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-F bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form ScF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-F bond lengths are 2.02 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and one Sc atom.
